question: Where can I get a list of data centers in operation in Germany, with location, operator and capacity (IT power in MW or floor area)?

answer.summary: Germany's official Energy Efficiency Register for Data Centres (RZReg, rechenzentrumsregister.bund.de) exports 323 operating facilities >=300 kW with operator, 5-digit postal code, IT load in kW (18 'n.v.'), and floor area in m². However, § 13 EnEfG allows external disclosure: 163 of 486 DCs in BAFA's 2025 statistics (and major international operators) omit RZReg publication, vs 2,980 MW estimated nationwide (Bitkom 2025). Combine RZReg with PeeringDB (328 DE sites, 321 with coordinates, no MW/m²), OpenStreetMap (273 telecom=data_center objects), and operator/BImSchG/PfA records.
main_caveats: RZReg exports 323 public DCs (593.38 MW IT load): 163 of 486 DCs in BAFA's 2025 statistics omit RZReg publication (including Equinix, Digital Realty, AWS, Google, Microsoft), vs 2,980 MW national IT capacity (Bitkom 2025).

RZReg exports 5-digit postal codes only (no street address or coordinates) and lists campus buildings separately, whereas PeeringDB often collapses multi-building campuses (e.g., Digital Realty FRA1-27) into one record.

RZReg loads are in kW (divide by 1,000 for MW): 18/323 rows report 'n.v.' for IT kW, 21 rows have IT kW >= non-redundant total load (UBA flagged a 12% error rate), and Vantage BER12 lists 1 kW on 12,080 m².
The EU European Database on Data Centres legally keeps facility-level records confidential (Reg. (EU) 2024/1364 Art. 5(5)) and publishes only Member State and EU aggregates.

BImSchG/UVP environmental permits show diesel backup thermal capacity (MWth FWL) rather than IT MW and cover both planned and operating sites; commercial trackers either block bots (HTTP 429) or sell site MW behind paid requests.
answer.confidence_reason: EnEfG § 13 law, BAFA/BfEE technical guides, RZReg XLSX/JSON (323 public; 486 in 2025 stats), UBA evaluation, PeeringDB DE API (328), OSM Taginfo/Geofabrik, operator pages, and Baxtel all directly verified.

attributes.note: RZReg gives only 5-digit postal codes; PeeringDB adds street address and coordinates (321/328); OSM gives coordinates/footprints.
attributes.gap_note: RZReg omits street addresses and coordinates by statutory design (Annex 3 No. 1d EnEfG); BImSchG/UVP permits and PfA give street/parcel locations case-by-case.

attributes.note: RZReg names owner and operator (169 distinct in 323 rows); PeeringDB lists org_name (147 distinct); OSM has operator tag.
attributes.gap_note: Equinix, Digital Realty, NTT Frankfurt campuses, AWS, Microsoft, and Google omit public RZReg entries; Baxtel CSV requires paid request.

coverage.geographic: Germany (national; 5-digit postal code only; 323 published entries across 169 operators)

unit.value: Rated IT load (PDIT) and non-redundant rated electrical load in kW (divide by 1,000 for MW); total floor area (SDC) in m²; total energy consumption in kWh.
unit.quote: 2.6 Data centre total floor area (“SDC”, in square meters) ... 2.8 Rated information technology load (“PDIT” in kW) ... The rated information technology load is defined as the maximum load the uninterruptible power supply (UPS) is built for. 2.9 Non-redundant rated electrical load (in kW)

inclusion_rule.value: Mandatory annual reporting for data centres with >= 300 kW non-redundant rated electrical load (§ 13(1) EnEfG); campus buildings normally count separately; publishing via RZReg itself is optional if published elsewhere.
inclusion_rule.quote: Grundsätzlich meldepflichtig sind Betreiber von Rechenzentren ab einer nicht redundanten elektrischen Nennanschlussleistung von 300 kW. Meldepflichtige Betreiber können ihre Jahresmeldungen über das RZReg veröffentlichen, sich aber auch für eine andere Art der Veröffentlichung entscheiden.

reference_date.value: Previous calendar year (latest submitted year in register API statistics is 2025; public Excel export generated live on 2026-11-15 with 323 facilities vs 319 on 2026-09-21).
reference_date.quote: In general, data centre operators are obliged to publish information about their data centre for the previous calendar year and to submit this information to the federal government by March 31st of each year.

update_frequency.value: Annual reporting cycle (due 31 March each year; public portal launched 2026-08-14 after initial reporting waves 2024-08-15 for >=500 kW and 2025-07-01 for 300-<500 kW; export updates incrementally).
update_frequency.quote: 1. Operators of data centres with a non-redundant rated electrical load of at least 500 kW must provide the information for the first time by August 15, 2024 at the latest, 2. Operators of data centres with a non-redundant rated electrical load of 300 kW to less than 500 kW must submit the information for the first time by July 1, 2025 at the latest.

exclusions.value: Excludes <300 kW facilities, predominantly transport/network nodes (§ 3 Nr. 24 c) EnEfG), and 163 of 486 reported DCs (plus unreported/non-compliant operators) that chose not to publish in RZReg (missing Equinix, Digital Realty, NTT Frankfurt, AWS, Microsoft, Google).
exclusions.quote: c) excluded from the regulations are data centres that serve to connect other data centers and which predominantly do not process the data (network nodes).

key_fields.meaning: Self-chosen data center identifier
Legal owner entity
Operating entity under § 3 Nr. 3 EnEfG
IT capacity bracket (<500kW, <1MW, <5MW, <10MW, <50MW, <100MW)
5-digit German ZIP code (string preserving leading zeros, no street or city column)
Data centre total floor area SDC in square meters
Rated IT load PDIT in kW (max UPS load; 'n.v.' in 18 rows)
Total facility non-redundant rated electrical load in kW ('n.v.' in 18 rows)
Annual total energy consumption EDC in kWh

key_fields.field: PUE / REF / ERF / WUE / Waste Heat Released (kWh)
key_fields.meaning: Annual energy, water, and waste heat efficiency indicators

how_to_use.example_result: {"data":[{"general":{"name":"1100203C BR FM03C Rechenzentrum Freimann","owner":"Bayerischer Rundfunk, Anstalt öffentlichen Rechts","operator":"Bayerischer Rundfunk, Anstalt öffentlichen Rechts","sizeClass":{"id":1,"name":"datacenterSizeClassLess500kW"},"postalCode":"80939","surfaceAreaInM2":1240,"itNominalConnectedLoadInKw":297,"nonRedundantNominalConnectedLoadInKw":450}...]} (XLSX contains 323 data rows starting at row 2).
steps: Download datacenters.xlsx directly from /api/portal-d/datacenters/export/download (no authentication required) or paginate /api/portal-d/datacenters?pager[size]=50&pager[page]=1.
Preserve Postal Code as a 5-character string (avoid numeric casting, which drops leading zeros such as 01099 or 08223).
Divide Connected Load IT (kW) and Connected Load Non-Redundant (kW) by 1000 to obtain MW; parse 'n.v.' strings as missing values.

Query /api/portal-d/statistics?cat=AMOUNT&year=2025 (or state ARS codes from /api/portal-d/common/federalStates) to compare public coverage against total BAFA-reported counts (486 national; 103 in Hessen state '06').
reading_traps: License note: footer links to BMWE Impressum (blocked by Radware to non-browser clients) and BfEE Impressum omits an explicit Datenlizenz Deutschland tag, while portal displays '© 2026 Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Energie'.

18 of 323 rows contain 'n.v.' in Connected Load IT (kW) and Non-Redundant (kW); 21 rows have IT kW >= Non-Redundant kW (including Vantage BER12 reporting 1 kW on 12,080 m²; 5 rows report non-redundant load <300 kW).
Only 323 of 486 DCs in BAFA's 2025 statistics appear here; major international operators (Equinix, Digital Realty, NTT Frankfurt, AWS, Google, Microsoft) have 0 matching entries.
Campus buildings are generally submitted as separate rows (e.g., Hetzner Online has 26 FSN1/NBG1 rows), unlike PeeringDB which often groups a campus into one record.

problems: 18/323 rows report 'n.v.' for Connected Load IT (kW) and Non-Redundant (kW); 21/323 have IT kW >= Non-Redundant kW.
Location is restricted to 5-digit Postal Code (no street address or coordinates); only 14 rows appear in Frankfurt PLZ 60xxx.

how_to_use.example_result: {"id": 58, "name": "Digital Realty Frankfurt FRA1-27", "org_name": "Digital Realty", "address1": "Hanauer Landstrasse 298", "city": "Frankfurt", "zipcode": "60314", "country": "DE", "latitude": 50.11925, "longitude": 8.735199, "updated": "2026-04-02T10:54:50Z"} (328 objects in data array).
steps: Fetch GET https://www.peeringdb.com/api/fac?country=DE once (or pass Authorization: Api-Key <key> to avoid anonymous rate limits) and save locally.
Extract id, name, org_name, address1, city, zipcode, latitude, longitude from the JSON data array.
Geocode the 7/328 DE records missing latitude/longitude using address1 + zipcode + city.
Deduplicate campus-grouped entries (e.g., Digital Realty Frankfurt FRA1-27 = 1 facility row) against building-level rows in RZReg or operator sites.
reading_traps: Repeated unauthenticated requests trigger HTTP 429 rate-limiting (observed immediately on second GET without API key); always cache the single 318 KB response.
7 of 328 DE facilities have null latitude/longitude; all 321 present coordinates fall inside Germany's bounding box (47.2<=lat<=55.1, 5.8<=lon<=15.1).
Multi-building colocation campuses are often collapsed into one facility (e.g. Digital Realty FRA1-27), whereas RZReg counts buildings individually.
Some entries include telecom PoPs / IX carrier rooms rather than standalone data center halls; no structured IT MW or m² fields exist.

problems: Subsequent anonymous API calls returned HTTP 429 rate limit.
7/328 records lack latitude/longitude; 320/328 lack any MW or area figure even in free-text notes.

regulator.name: Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Energie (BMWE) / Bundesamt für Wirtschaft und Ausfuhrkontrolle (BAFA — Bundesstelle für Energieeffizienz, BfEE Referat 512)

operators.note: Fragmented market of colocation, hyperscale cloud, telecom, enterprise, university/research, and public-sector operators: 169 distinct operators appear in RZReg's 323 public entries, 486 DCs reported for 2025 in BAFA stats, plus smaller (<300 kW) and network-node sites.

publication_obligation.norm: § 13 Abs. 1 EnEfG (Energieeffizienzgesetz, BGBl. 2023 I Nr. 309) & Anlage 3; Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1364 for >=500 kW IT load
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Name, owner, operator, size class, 5-digit postal code, total floor area (m²), rated IT load PDIT (kW), non-redundant rated electrical load (kW), data traffic/bandwidth, total energy consumption (kWh), REF, PUE, ERF, CER, WUE and waste heat metrics.
publication_obligation.frequency: Annual, for the preceding calendar year by 31 March (after initial phase-in: 2024-08-15 for >=500 kW and 2025-07-01 for 300-<500 kW).

consolidated_republication.note: Federal collection under § 13 EnEfG holds 486 facilities (2025 stats), but only 323 appear in the public RZReg export because external publication is permitted; EU EED records remain confidential by law.

checked_pages.saw: FAQ confirms operators must report >=300 kW DCs but may fulfill public disclosure either via RZReg (323 public rows) or another medium; anonymized /de/statistic/ aggregates cover 486 reported DCs in 2025.
2026-08-14 announcement of the public RZReg platform; confirms it publishes annual reports under § 13(1) EnEfG where operators authorized portal publication.

2026-09-21 evaluation confirms 319 published DCs then, many international operators missing because RZReg publication is optional, and sampled company websites lacked site-level § 13 EnEfG breakdowns.
Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1364 Art. 5(2) and 5(5) explicitly mandate confidentiality of facility-level data and publication only at Member State and Union aggregate level.

national_registry.note: Germany operates an official national Energy Efficiency Register for Data Centres (RZReg, launched 2026-08-14), but it is legally partial: excludes <300 kW non-redundant load and network nodes, allows external disclosure instead of RZReg publication (323 public rows vs 486 reported in 2025 stats), and omits street addresses/coordinates.

checked_pages.saw: Official ministry landing page linking to the RZReg portal, PDF data point guides, and FAQ for § 13 EnEfG reporting >=300 kW.
Administering unit (Referat 512) confirming statutory reporting scope, March 31 annual deadline, and link to RZReg platform.
Independent federal assessment (2026-09-21) documenting large coverage gaps in public RZReg (missing major international operators) and 12% data quality errors.
Electricity grid connection rules and construction cost contributions (Baukostenzuschüsse); publishes no registry of connected data centers.
EU database reporting portal gated by EU Login; facility-level records withheld under Reg. (EU) 2024/1364 Art. 5 in favor of aggregated Qlik indicators.
165,423 federated datasets across Germany; CKAN API queries for Rechenzentrum/Rechenzentren returned 0 national data center lists.

recipe: Start with RZReg's 323-facility datacenters.xlsx as the baseline with verified IT kW, non-redundant kW, and floor area (m²), fixing 'n.v.' and IT >= non-redundant anomalies.
Compare RZReg state/postal counts against /api/portal-d/statistics?cat=AMOUNT&year=2025 (486 national; 103 in Hessen state '06') to quantify omitted facilities per Bundesland.

Union missing colocation and interconnection facilities from PeeringDB (/api/fac?country=DE, 328 facilities) and OpenStreetMap (Geofabrik germany-latest.osm.pbf filtered on telecom=data_center / building=data_center), deduplicating PeeringDB campus records against building-level rows.

Cross-search known missing operators (Equinix, Digital Realty, NTT, AWS, Microsoft, Google, CyrusOne, StackIT, Colt, Global Switch, Telehouse) across BfEE PfA XLSX, operator websites (e.g., Digital Realty FRA1–FRA32 pages for m²), and UVP-Verbund / BImSchG PDFs.

Verify operational vs under-construction status by checking Inbetriebnahme (commissioning) dates in BImSchG/UVP notices, commercial status on operator/Baxtel pages, and recent DOP20 aerial orthophotos + ALKIS parcels.
if_unstructured.location_method: RZReg gives only 5-digit postal codes. Resolve exact facility positions by matching operator/site names to PeeringDB lat/lon coordinates (321/328 DE sites), OSM building polygons (telecom=data_center / building=data_center), BfEE PfA street addresses, or Gemarkung/Flur/Flurstück parcel IDs in BImSchG/UVP notices resolved through Länder ALKIS WFS services and checked against DOP20 orthophotos.
cross_with: BfEE Plattform für Abwärme XLSX (exact street addresses for companies >=2.5 GWh/yr including NTT, Telehouse, Global Switch, Colt, Microsoft, Vantage)
UVP-Verbund / state BImSchG permits (applicant, street, Gemarkung/Flur/Flurstück, expected commissioning year)
Länder ALKIS WFS services (e.g., HVBG Hessen WFS) & DOP20 orthophotos (footprint and construction confirmation)
Operator Germany/Frankfurt facility brochures & § 13 corporate disclosures

where_published.name: UVP-Verbund (Federal & Länder Environmental Impact / BImSchG Portal)
where_published.what: Environmental assessment and BImSchG public permitting notices for large data centers requiring emergency diesel backup permits (1.1 GE / 4. BImSchV).
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Query /freitextsuche?q=Rechenzentrum, Notstromdiesel, or Netzersatzanlage (space requests slowly; rapid scraping of detail pages triggers HTTP 429).

example_document.what_it_gives: Applicant NTT Global Data Centers BER3 GmbH, exact site Rigipsstraße 4-6, 14656 Brieselang, parcel Gemarkung Bredow Flur 8 Flurstücke 423/437/438, 64 diesel units (384.96 MWth thermal firing power), planned commissioning October 2027.

where_published.name: State Environmental Permitting Authorities (e.g., Regierungspräsidium Darmstadt BImSchG Notices)
where_published.what: Final § 4 / § 16 BImSchG approval PDFs published by regional authorities (Regierungspräsidien / Landesämter), confirming permitted applicant, exact address, cadastral parcel, and generator expansion stages.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Search state environment portals or Google/search engines for 'Genehmigungsbescheid' 'Rechenzentrum' 'BImSchG' by Land/municipality (e.g., Regierungspräsidium Darmstadt for Frankfurt/Hessen).

example_document.what_it_gives: Genehmigungsbescheid (2022-07-26) for A 100 ROW GmbH, Eschborner Landstraße 100, 60489 Frankfurt am Main, Gemarkung Rödelheim Flur 26 Flurstück 1/19 (Rechenzentrum Bauteil C), 14 diesel units totaling 69.86 MWth FWL.

where_published.name: BfEE Plattform für Abwärme (PfA) — Company Address Cross-Reference
where_published.what: Downloadable XLSX (24,197 rows across >3,000 companies >=2.5 GWh/yr under § 17 EnEfG) revealing exact street addresses of non-RZReg data center operators.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Download pfa_datentabelle_excel.xlsx and filter column C (company name) and column D (site name/street) for known DC operators (NTT, Colt, Telehouse, Global Switch, Microsoft, Vantage).

example_document.what_it_gives: Verified street addresses for Telehouse Deutschland FRA 1 (Kleyerstraße 75-87, 60326), Global Switch FM GmbH (Eschborner Landstr. 110, 60489), Colt (Hanauer Landstrasse 326, 60314), NTT FRA2/MUC1, Microsoft München, and Vantage BER21/FRA11/FRA21 (no IT MW or m²).

related_not_answering.name: BfEE Plattform für Abwärme (PfA)
related_not_answering.why: Covers all commercial/industrial firms >=2.5 GWh/yr (24,197 rows across >3,000 firms): has no data-center facility-type column and reports waste heat thermal capacity (kWth, °C, kWh/a), not IT MW or floor area.

related_not_answering.name: RZReg Aggregated Statistics (/de/statistic/ & API)
related_not_answering.why: Publishes national/Land counts (486 DCs in 2025; 103 in Hessen), mean connected load, and consumption by size/type, but omits facility names/locations and suppresses small cells ('VnV').

related_not_answering.name: EU European Database on Data Centres & Qlik Dashboard
related_not_answering.why: Reporting platform requires EU Login and individual facility KPIs are legally confidential under Reg. (EU) 2024/1364 Art. 5(2)&(5); only Member State and EU aggregates are public.

related_not_answering.name: Bitkom / Borderstep Study: Rechenzentren in Deutschland (Update 2025)
related_not_answering.why: Market report with aggregate capacity (2,980 MW IT load in 2025, >1,100 MW in greater Frankfurt, 21.3 TWh electricity) and no facility-level list.

related_not_answering.name: German Datacenter Association — Data Center Impact Report Deutschland 2024
related_not_answering.why: Industry association economic impact summary without a facility roster or downloadable dataset.

related_not_answering.name: Bundesnetzagentur (BNetzA) — Netzanschluss
related_not_answering.why: Grid connection regulatory framework and construction cost contribution guidance; contains no public list of connected data centers.

open_questions: Which exact 163 data centers reported to BAFA for 2025 (486 total vs 323 in the public XLSX export) chose external § 13 EnEfG publication, and what facility-level IT MW / floor area did they report confidentially to BAFA?

history.note: Initial research: official RZReg covers 323 DCs >=300 kW (PLZ only, optional portal disclosure vs 486 reported in 2025 stats); combined with PeeringDB (328 DE sites), OSM (273), operator pages, and Baxtel.

local_terms.meaning: Data center (§ 3 Nr. 24 EnEfG: centralized IT/telecom facility >=300 kW non-redundant load, excluding network nodes)
Federal Energy Efficiency Register for Data Centres administered by BAFA/BfEE under BMWE
Rated electrical connected load (non-redundant total NAL-RZ vs rated IT load NAL-IT / PDIT via UPS)
Data centre total floor area in m² (Annex 3 No. 1 e) EnEfG)
Annual data center report submitted by 31 March for the previous calendar year (§ 13 EnEfG)
BAFA/BfEE waste heat registry (§ 17 EnEfG, companies >2.5 GWh/yr) listing street addresses & thermal kW
Backup diesel generator installation triggering BImSchG § 4 / UVPG environmental permits above thermal MWth thresholds
Fuel thermal input power in MWth for backup diesel engines (not IT electrical load)
